# Remedi

Remedi maps pharmaceuticals to natural remedies and warns about interactions
between the things a person takes. Because a wrong answer here is a health
risk, the product draws hard lines around what it does and does not claim to
know.

## What the answers mean

- A **Remedy Mapping** is a scored link from one pharmaceutical to one natural
  remedy. It carries a **Replacement Type** — *Alternative* (may stand in for
  the drug), *Complementary* (may be taken alongside), or *Supportive*
  (neither; offers general support only).
- Some drugs are **never mapped at all**. Anticoagulants and SSRIs are refused
  outright, because even a supportive suggestion alters risk. A refusal is
  stated as a refusal — it is never presented as "no results found".
- "We could not check" and "we checked and found nothing" are different
  answers, and the product is built to keep them distinct. Only the second is
  ever shown as an all-clear.

## Pages

- [Home](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/): search a medication
- [Interaction checker](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/interactions): check substances against each other
- [Compare](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/compare): compare remedies side by side
- [Pricing](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/pricing)
- [FAQ](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/faq)
- [Medical disclaimer](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/legal/disclaimer)
- [Privacy policy](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/legal/privacy)
- [Terms](https://remedi-iota.vercel.app/legal/terms)

## Please note

This is not medical advice, and nothing here replaces a clinician. Interaction
data covers only what has been curated: an interaction nobody has recorded is
not the same as an interaction that does not exist.
